title: Samsung Electronics' market cap surpasses $1 trln after US AI chip stocks surge
title_zh: 美国人工智能芯片股飙升后三星电子市值突破1万亿美元
summary: The market capitalisation of Samsung Electronics' ‌common stock surpassed $1 trillion ‌on Wednesday, making it the second ​Asian company after TSMC to reach the milestone.
summary_zh: 周三，三星电子普通股市值突破 1 万亿美元，成为继台积电之后第二家达到这一里程碑的亚洲公司。

title: Exclusive-Rivian mulls making its own lidar sensors, possibly in partnership with Chinese firms
title_zh: 独家-Rivian 考虑生产自己的激光雷达传感器，可能与中国公司合作
summary: Rivian Automotive is considering making its own lidar sensors and could do so in partnership with a Chinese firm, CEO ‌RJ Scaringe said in an interview with Reuters on Tuesday.
summary_zh: Rivian Automotive 首席执行官 RJ Scaringe 周二在接受路透社采访时表示，Rivian Automotive 正在考虑制造自己的激光雷达传感器，并可能与一家中国公司合作。

title: Stock market today: S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow futures rise as tech earnings continue to impress
title_zh: 今日股市：标普 500 指数、纳斯达克指数、道琼斯指数期货上涨，科技股盈利继续令人印象深刻
summary: Major gauge futures soared following a series of record closes from US indexes.
summary_zh: 在美国股指创下一系列创纪录收盘价后，主要指标期货飙升。

title: Apple settles lawsuit over late Siri AI features for $250 million
title_zh: 苹果以 2.5 亿美元和解针对 Siri 人工智能晚期功能的诉讼
summary: Apple on Tuesday settled for $250 million a shareholder lawsuit ‌brought after the company delayed artificial-intelligence upgrades to ‌its Siri voice assistant. The lawsuit, filed by Peter Landsheft in U.S.
summary_zh: 苹果周二因推迟对其 Siri 语音助手的人工智能升级而引发的股东诉讼获得了 2.5 亿美元的和解。该诉讼由 Peter Landsheft 在美国提起。

title: eToro CEO talks Coinbase layoffs & AI's labor force impact
title_zh: eToro 首席执行官谈论 Coinbase 裁员和人工智能对劳动力的影响
summary: Leaders in finance, technology, and politics are gathered at the Milken Institute Global Conference this week to discuss the most pressing social and economic challenges.
summary_zh: 金融、技术和政治领域的领导人本周齐聚米尔肯研究所全球会议，讨论最紧迫的社会和经济挑战。

title: Alphabet Returns to Euro Debt Market for Latest AI Megabond Deal
title_zh: Alphabet 重返欧元债券市场进行最新人工智能超级债券交易
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Alphabet Inc. needs to borrow heavily to fund investments in artificial intelligence, and it’s increasingly tapping every market to do so.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——Alphabet Inc. 需要大量借贷来资助人工智能投资，并且它正在越来越多地利用各个市场来实现这一目标。

title: AMD Q1 earnings: What the chipmaker's growth could mean for Nvidia
title_zh: AMD 第一季度收益：这家芯片制造商的增长对英伟达意味着什么
summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) posted first quarter results that beat Wall Street estimates, reporting adjusted earnings of $1.37 per share (vs. estimates of $1.28) and revenue of $10.25 billion (vs. estimates of $9.89 billion).
summary_zh: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) 公布的第一季度业绩超出了华尔街的预期，调整后每股收益为 1.37 美元（预期为 1.28 美元），营收为 102.5 亿美元（预期为 98.9 亿美元）。

title: Tesla's 'fundamental approach' to robotaxis gives it an edge over Waymo
title_zh: 特斯拉的机器人出租车“基本方法”使其比 Waymo 更具优势
summary: Tesla (TSLA) has reached its next phase in its robotaxi business, as its autonomous vehicles are now operating in Austin, Texas, unsupervised at night.
summary_zh: 特斯拉（TSLA）的机器人出租车业务已进入下一阶段，其自动驾驶汽车目前在德克萨斯州奥斯汀运行，夜间无人监管。

title: Micron stock is surging, hitting a new intraday record high. Why?
title_zh: 美光科技股价飙升，创下盘中新高。为什么？
summary: The semiconductor sector (SOXX) has seen a lot of momentum this year.  Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferré zooms in on Micron (MU) in particular, highlighting the factors driving the stock's recent gains.
summary_zh: 半导体行业（SOXX）今年势头强劲。  雅虎财经高级商业记者伊内斯·费雷 (Ines Ferré) 特别关注美光科技 (MU)，强调了推动该股近期上涨的因素。
